title: Game
description: The Game type represents things which are games. These are typically rule-governed recreational activities, e.g. role-playing games in which players assume the role of characters in a fictional setting.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

characterAttribute.title: Character Attribute
characterAttribute.description: A piece of data that represents a particular aspect of a fictional character (skill, power, character points, advantage, disadvantage).

gameItem.title: Game Item
gameItem.description: An item is an object within the game world that can be collected by a player or, occasionally, a non-player character.

gameLocation.title: Game Location
gameLocation.description: Real or fictional location of the game (or part of game).

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: PostalAddress [value-type]: PostalAddress -> ContactPoint -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing; Place [entity]: Place -> Thing

numberOfPlayers.title: Number Of Players
numberOfPlayers.description: Indicate how many people can play this game (minimum, maximum, or range).

quest.title: Quest
quest.description: The task that a player-controlled character, or group of characters may complete in order to gain a reward.
